summary.text: Eric Michael Foreman is the Libertarian Party nominee for Nebraska's 2nd Congressional District, with a career in property management. His campaign centers on ending U.S. involvement in foreign wars, cutting taxes for people earning under $200,000, and opposing what he calls government overreach.

paragraphs.text: Foreman describes himself as a blue-collar worker who has "worked honest jobs" and is not a career politician, and he says he has raised a family "the hard way—without handouts or shortcuts."
He advanced from the May 12, 2026 Libertarian Party primary to the general election ballot.
